arXiv:2607.19300v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 7 月 21 日arXiv:2607.19300v1 [cs.AI] 21 Jul 2026

LLM 检测作为干预措施：战略用户行为下的下游影响LLM Detection as an Intervention: Downstream Impact under Strategic User Behavior

Meena Jagadeesan Stanford University University of Pennsylvania Tatsunori Hashimoto Stanford University Jon Kleinberg Cornell University
摘要Abstract

随着 LLM 的采用变得更加广泛，人们对检测 LLM 生成的内容越来越感兴趣，例如通过 LLM 检测工具和基于语言模式的启发式方法。检测器作为一种干预措施，不仅引导检测到的属性本身，还引导下游指标，例如 LLM 使用和输出质量。在这项工作中，我们展示了不完美的 LLM 检测器如何通过扭曲用户在工作流程中使用 LLM 的激励方式，对这些下游指标产生违反直觉的影响。我们开发了一个程式化模型，该模型捕获用户如何战略性地选择使用 LLM 的程度以及如何对内容进行后处理以减少检测到的属性。使用这个模型，我们表明 LLM 检测可以违反直觉地导致人们增加他们的 LLM 使用率。此外，即使减少检测到的属性可以提高输出质量，我们发现引入 LLM 检测器也会导致用户产生较低质量的输出。相比之下，我们表明检测器会为检测到的属性产生清晰的“上升然后下降”模式，我们根据经验在 arXiv 摘要上重现词频。总而言之，我们的工作说明了 LLM 检测如何扭曲 LLM 的使用和输出质量，并在 LLM 检测器作为对这些下游指标的干预时发现故障模式。As LLM adoption becomes more widespread, there is a growing interest in detecting LLM-generated content, for example through LLM detection tools and through heuristics based on language patterns. Detectors operate as an intervention that steers not only the detected attribute itself, but also downstream metrics such as LLM usage and output quality. In this work, we demonstrate how imperfect LLM detectors lead to counterintuitive impacts on these downstream metrics, by distorting how users are incentivized to use LLMs in their workflow. We develop a stylized model which captures how users strategically choose how much to use the LLM and how to post-process content to reduce the detected attribute. Using this model, we show that LLM detection can counterintuitively lead humans to increase their LLM usage. Moreover, even when reducing the detected attribute improves output quality, we find that introducing an LLM detector can lead users to produce lower quality outputs. In contrast, we show that detectors result in a clean “rise-then-fall” pattern for the detected attribute, which we empirically reproduce for word frequencies on arXiv abstracts. Altogether, our work illustrates how LLM detection can distort LLM usage and output quality, uncovering failure modes when LLM detectors operate as an intervention on these downstream metrics.

1 简介Introduction

随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 得到更大规模的部署，内容是否是 LLM 生成的还是人工生成的内容受到越来越多的审查。这导致了LLM检测工具的部署As large language models (LLMs) get deployed at larger scale, content is increasingly scrutinized for whether it is LLM-generated or human-generated. This has led to the deployment of LLM detection tools(Mitchell et al., 2023; Verma et al., 2024; Hans et al., 2024; Adam et al., 2026)例如 GPTZero 和 Pangramsuch as GPTZero and Pangram111参见Seehttps://gptzero.me和andhttps://www.pangram.com/.在学术会议上in academic conferences(ICLR 2026 Program Chairs, 2026)以及在教育方面and in education(Prothero, 2024)，以及其他域（示例, among other domains (Example1）。除了这些自动化工具之外，LLM 检测是由社会使用基于语言模式的启发法隐式执行的（例如，增加“delve”等特定单词的使用）). Beyond these automated tools, LLM detection is performed implicitly by society using heuristics based on language patterns (e.g., increased usage of specific words such as “delve”(Liang et al., 2025; Juzek and Ward, 2025)以及破折号等风格模式and stylistic patterns such as em-dashes(Wu, 2025)）。基于社会的检测可能会损害作者，例如导致对内容质量的负面看法). Society-based detection can harm authors, for example by leading to negative perceptions of content quality(Knight et al., 2023)（示例(Example2).

LLM 检测，无论是由机构还是社会执行，都是对几个下游指标的干预。其中一个指标是 LLM 使用情况：例如，教育工作者可能会部署 LLM 检测器以尝试LLM detection, whether performed by institutions or by society, operates as an intervention on several downstream metrics. One such metric is LLM usage: for example, educators may deploy LLM detectors in an attempt to减少reduce法学硕士的使用。另一个此类指标是输出质量：学术研究机构可能会部署 LLM 检测器，以便LLM usage. Another such metric is output quality: academic research institutions may deploy LLM detectors in order to增加increase学术出版物的质量。另一个指标是检测器直接惩罚的属性。例如，arXiv 上特定词模式的频率the quality of academic publications. Yet another metric is the attribute that the detector directly penalizes. For example, the frequency of specific word patterns on arXiv(Liang et al., 2025; Geng and Trotta, 2024)经验上表现出“先升后降”的模式，在 ChatGPT 发布后急剧增加，但随后在接下来的几个月中频率下降empirically exhibits a “rise-then-fall” pattern, dramatically increasing after the release of ChatGPT, but then subsequently dropping in frequency in the following months(Geng and Trotta, 2025; Leiter et al., 2024)，也许是因为社会开始意识到LLM听起来的词。, perhaps due to society becoming aware of LLM-sounding words.

然而，LLM 检测和这些下游指标之间的联系因用户激励而变得复杂：不完善的 LLM 检测器从根本上扭曲了用户将 LLM 集成到其工作流程中的激励方式。自动和启发式 LLM 检测器经常对内容进行错误分类However, the link between LLM detection and these downstream metrics is complicated by user incentives: imperfect LLM detectors fundamentally distort how users are incentivized to integrate LLMs into their workflow. Automated and heuristic LLM detectors routinely misclassify content(Liang et al., 2023; Weber-Wulff et al., 2023)对小扰动不具有鲁棒性and are non-robust to small perturbations(Krishna et al., 2023; Sadasivan et al., 2025)，并且在人类与法学硕士合作下，正确性本质上是不明确的, and correctness is inherently ambiguous under human-LLM collaboration(Zhang et al., 2024)。为了避免检测，用户可能会被激励对 LLM 生成的内容进行后处理. To avoid detection, users may be incentivized to post-process LLM-generated content222https://www.quetext.com/blog/top-prompts-humanize-ai-generated-text甚至是他们自己的人工生成的内容or even their own human-generated content(Wu, 2025)，例如通过删除听起来像 LLM 的单词的实例（示例, for example by removing instances of LLM-sounding words (Example2）。 用户也可能会被激励去改变他们委托给法学硕士的工作量，例如决定手动执行一些任务（例如参考文献生成）以避免检测（示例). Users may also be incentivized to change how much work they delegate to the LLM, for example by deciding to perform some tasks (e.g., reference generation) manually to avoid detection (Example1).

在这项工作中，我们研究了用户激励的这种扭曲，并展示了不完善的 LLM 检测如何导致 对下游指标的反直觉影响。在我们的程式化模型中（部分In this work, we study this distortion of user incentives, and show how imperfect LLM detection can lead to counterintuitive impacts on downstream metrics. In our stylized model (Section2），输出嵌入), outputs are embedded inDD-维度：LLM 检测器在第一个维度（检测到的属性）上使用基于阈值的分类器标记输出，但质量取决于所有维度-dimensions: the LLM detector flags outputs using a threshold-based classifier on the first dimension (detected attribute), but quality depends on allDD尺寸。如果 LLM 检测器标记了输出，则创作该输出的用户将受到处罚。每个用户选择分配给法学硕士的工作量，这决定了他们自己自然生成的输出和完全由法学硕士生成的输出之间的凸组合。用户还可以通过减少检测到的属性来决定对内容进行后处理的程度（这可以帮助他们避免被检测器标记）。他们优化其效用，即输出质量、检测惩罚、生产成本和后处理成本的组合。dimensions. If an output is flagged by the LLM detector, the user who authored it incurs a penalty. Each user chooses how much work to allocate to an LLM, which determines the convex combination between their own natural human-generated output and their fully LLM-generated output. The user also decides how much to post-process content by reducing the detected attribute (which may help them avoid being flagged by the detector). They optimize for their utility which is a combination of output quality, the detection penalty, production costs, and post-processing costs.

使用此模型，我们证明 LLM 检测可能会扭曲 LLM 的使用和输出质量，即使它对其优化的指标有明显的影响。Using this model, we prove that LLM detection can distort both LLM usage and output quality, even though it has a clean impact on the metric that it optimizes.

    法学硕士用途：LLM usage:引入 LLM 检测器可能会导致一些用户Introducing an LLM detector can lead some users to增加increase他们的法学硕士使用相对于无检测器基线（第their LLM usage relative to the no-detector baseline (Section3;图; Figure1(a)）。 具体来说，我们展示了存在在检测下增加 LLM 使用率的用户的充分条件（定理). Specifically, we show sufficient conditions under which there exist users who increase LLM usage under detection (Theorem1），以及必要条件（定理), as well as necessary conditions (Theorem2）在 LLM 使用中质量呈线性的情况下匹配。虽然人们可能期望检测会导致用户减少 LLM 使用以降低检测到的属性，但我们的结果显示相反的情况也可能发生。直觉是，后处理可以消除 LLM 产生的一些降低质量的特征，这可能会激励用户有选择地更多地利用那些 LLM 生成的内容可能比人类生成的内容质量更高的特征（示例) that match in the case where quality is linear in LLM usage. While one may expect that detection would lead users to reduce LLM usage to lower the detected attribute, our result shows the opposite can occur. The intuition is that post-processing can remove some quality-reducing characteristics produced by the LLM, which may incentivize users to selectively take greater advantage of those characteristics where LLM-generated content may be higher quality than human-generated content (Example3).

    输出质量：Output quality:引入 LLM 检测器可以引导用户生产Introducing an LLM detector can lead users to produce质量较低lower-quality相对于基线的输出，即使检测到的属性会降低质量（第outputs relative to the baseline, even when the detected attribute is quality-reducing (Section4;图; Figure1(b)）。我们证明了存在在检测下产生低质量输出的用户的充分条件（定理). We prove sufficient conditions under which there exist users who produce lower-quality outputs under detection (Theorem3）。虽然当检测惩罚降低质量的特征时，人们可能期望 LLM 检测器能够提高质量，但我们的结果表明，检测可能会违反直觉地降低质量。直觉是，检测可能会导致用户未充分使用 LLM，从而失去使用 LLM 可以提高质量的（未检测到的）维度（示例). While one may expect the LLM detector to improve quality when detection penalizes a quality-reducing characteristic, our result shows that detection can counterintuitively reduce quality. The intuition is that detection can lead users to under-use the LLM, and thereby lose the (non-detected) dimensions in which LLM use can increase quality (Example4).333定理中的条件The conditions in Theorem3不满足定理的必要条件do not satisfy the necessary conditions in Theorem2，这意味着 LLM 检测会微弱地降低 LLM 使用率。, meaning that LLM detection weakly decreases LLM usage.

    检测到的属性：Detected attribute:我们的模型重现了根据经验观察到的检测到的属性的“上升然后下降”模式Our model reproduces the empirically observed “rise-then-fall” pattern for the detected attribute(Geng and Trotta, 2025; Leiter et al., 2024)（节(Section5;图; Figure1(c)）。我们证明，当用户获得 LLM 访问权限时，检测到的属性总是微弱增加，然后随着检测器微弱减少（定理). We prove the detected attribute always weakly increases when the user is given access to an LLM and then weakly decreases with the detector (Theorem4）。从实证的角度来看，我们为这种模式提供了更系统的实证验证。超越所研究的特定单词列表). From an empirical perspective, we provide more systematic empirical validation of this pattern. Moving beyond the specific word lists studied inGeng and Trotta (2025)和andLeiter et al. (2024)，我们发现，相对于过去十年的之前时间窗口，“先升后降”模式在 LLM 时代的流行程度有所增加（图, we show the “rise-then-fall” pattern has increased in prevalence in the LLM era relative to prior time windows over the past decade (Figure2).

总而言之，我们的工作说明了 LLM 检测在考虑它如何影响用户工作流程决策时的意外影响。更广泛地说，当机构部署检测器来干预法学硕士的使用和输出质量时，这些失真结果揭示了关键的故障模式。Altogether, our work illustrates the unintended impacts of LLM detection, when accounting for how it shapes user workflow decisions. More broadly, these distortion results uncover key failure modes when institutions deploy detectors to intervene on LLM usage and output quality.

1.1 相关工作Related Work

我们的模型建立在以下文献的基础上Our model builds on the literature on战略分类strategic classification和and人机协作human-AI collaboration.

战略分类。Strategic classification.

关于策略分类的大量理论文献研究了用户如何策略性地改变其特征以改善其分类结果（参见A vast theoretical literature on strategic classification studies how users strategically change their features to improve their classification outcomes (see(Rosenfeld, 2024; Podimata, 2025)用于调查）。其中一项工作重点是用户如何“玩弄”分类器以改变其输入的特征而不改善其真实结果（例如，for surveys). One line of work focuses on how users can “game” the classifier to shift the features of their input without improving their true outcome (e.g.,(Hardt et al., 2016; Dong et al., 2018; Hu et al., 2019; Milli et al., 2019; Ghalme et al., 2021; Bechavod et al., 2022)）。通常关注的是在游戏中表现良好的分类器。另一条工作重点是用户如何采取行动，不仅改变他们的功能，而且“改善”他们的真实结果（例如，). The typical focus is on classifiers that perform well under gaming. Another line of work focuses on how users can take actions that not only change their features but also “improve” their true outcome (e.g.,(Kleinberg and Raghavan, 2020; Alon et al., 2020)），研究如何解释和解开博弈与改进（例如，), investigating how to account for and disentangle gaming and improvement (e.g.,(Miller et al., 2020; Shavit et al., 2020; Haghtalab et al., 2020; Ahmadi et al., 2022)）。我们的后处理模型直接建立在游戏模型的基础上). Our model of post-processing directly builds on the model for gaming inHardt et al. (2016)。与改进模型类似，我们捕获改变检测到的属性如何影响质量。我们工作的一个显着特点是，我们将后处理与人机协作相结合，展示了这种联合决策如何从根本上影响下游指标的用户激励和检测器性能。. Similar to the improvement models, we capture how changing the detected attribute affects quality. A distinguishing feature of our work is that we combine post-processing with human-AI collaboration, showing how this joint decision fundamentally shapes user incentives and detector performance along downstream metrics.

更广泛地说，我们的工作有助于越来越多关于法学硕士背景下战略行为的文献。这包括在线平台上的战略性法学硕士使用More broadly, our work contributes to a growing literature on the strategic behaviors in the context of LLMs. This includes the strategic LLM usage on online platforms(Yao et al., 2024; Ali et al., 2025; Keinan and Ben-Porat, 2026)，法学硕士对市场的战略影响, the strategic impacts of LLMs in markets(Lucier et al., 2026; Fish et al., 2024)，以及招聘中的战略性法学硕士操纵, and strategic LLM manipulations in hiring(Cohen et al., 2025).

我们的工作也符合更广泛的研究视角，将预测视为对社会系统的干预Our work also fits into a broader research perspective of viewing predictions as interventions in social systems(Liu et al., 2025).

人机协作。Human-AI collaboration.

关于人类与人工智能协作的大量理论文献研究了如何设计和评估人类与人工智能团队。这些作品考虑了许多模型：例如，基于呈现子集的模型（例如，A vast theoretical literature on human-AI collaboration studies how to design and evaluate human-AI teams. These works consider many models: for example, models based on presenting subsets (e.g.,(Straitouri et al., 2023; Donahue et al., 2024; Hullman et al., 2025)）、委托（例如，), delegation (e.g.,(Lai et al., 2022; Greenwood et al., 2025)），并随着时间的推移学习（例如，), and learning over time (e.g.,(Collina et al., 2025; Noorani et al., 2026)）。一个关键的需求是互补性（例如，). A key desideratum is complementarity (e.g.,(Bansal et al., 2021; Donahue et al., 2022; Rastogi et al., 2022)），其中指出人类 LLM 团队的表现必须比任何一个代理人单独表现得更好。我们的模型将人类与人工智能协作的简化视图视为插值；一个显着的特点是我们将人类与人工智能的协作与后处理相结合。我们的模型在理想化情况下表现出互补性，但我们表明 LLM 检测可能会损害互补性（图), which captures that the human-LLM team must perform better than either agent can perform in isolation. Our model takes a simplified view of human-AI collaboration as interpolation; a distinguishing feature is that we combine human-AI collaboration with post-processing. Our model exhibits complementarity in idealized cases, but we show LLM detection can compromise complementarity (Figure1(b);定理; Theorem3).

2 型号Model

我们开发了一个程式化模型，该模型捕获了 LLM 检测下用户激励的以下关键特征。首先，检测器与输出质量的某些（但不是全部）方面相关。其次，用户可以将任务的小数部分分配给法学硕士。第三，用户可以对输出进行后处理，以避免检测。最后，用户在能力水平和生产成本方面存在差异。We develop a stylized model which captures the following key features of user incentives under LLM detection. First, the detector is correlated with some, but not all, aspects of output quality. Second, users can assign fractional parts of the task to the LLM. Third, users can post-process their outputs to try to avoid detection. Finally, users are heterogeneous in terms of ability level and production costs.

3 对 LLM 使用的影响Impact on LLM Usage

乍一看，引入 LLM 检测器似乎会微弱地减少 LLM 使用率At first glance, it may seem that introducing an LLM detector would weakly decrease LLM usageα𝐭​(β,ν;Q,C)\alpha^{\mathbf{t}}(\beta,\nu;Q,C)相对于无检测器基线relative to the no-detector baselineα𝐭​(∅;Q,C)\alpha^{\mathbf{t}}(\emptyset;Q,C)。因为我们假设检测到的用户 LLM 生成内容的属性严格大于检测到的用户人工生成内容的属性（. Since we assume that the detected attribute for a user’s LLM-generated content is strictly larger than the detected attribute for the user’s human-generated content (ℓ1𝐭>h1𝐭\ell^{\mathbf{t}}_{1}>h^{\mathbf{t}}_{1}），LLM 检测似乎会导致用户减少 LLM 使用，以降低检测到的属性。), LLM detection may seem to lead users to reduce their LLM usage in order to lower the detected attribute.

我们在本节中的结果说明了这个论点是如何分解的：我们发现引入 LLM 检测器可能会违反直觉地导致一些用户增加他们的 LLM 使用率。Our results in this section illustrate how this argument breaks down: we find that introducing an LLM detector can counterintuitively lead some users to increase their LLM usage.

Given that they have to do this post-processing anyway, authors may be incentivized to use an LLM to take advantage of its interesting arguments.

定理证明草图Proof sketch of Theorem3.

直觉如下，如图所示The intuition is as follows and is depicted in Figure1(b)。这个想法是，后处理带来的质量提高可以通过法学硕士使用量的减少来抵消。具体来说，假设在未检测到的特征（如第二维捕获的特征）上，LLM 生成的内容比人类生成的内容质量更高。我们认为这种质量差距足够小，以便用户严格减少检测下的 LLM 使用。质量差距需要足够大，以便用户在无检测器基线中创建 LLM 生成的内容，并且质量差距也需要足够大，以便减少 LLM 使用会降低输出质量，足以抵消后处理带来的任何质量提高。证明见附录. The idea is that quality increase from post-processing can be offset by decrease in LLM usage. Specifically, suppose that the LLM-generated content is higher quality than human-generated content on non-detected characteristics (as captured by the second dimension). We take this quality gap to be small enough that users strictly reduce LLM usage under detection. The quality gap needs to be large enough that users create LLM-generated content in the no-detector baseline, and the gap also needs to be large enough that reducing LLM usage reduces output quality enough to offset any quality increase from post-processing. The proof is in AppendixE.

说明性例子。Illustrative examples.

提炼支撑定理的直觉To distill the intuition underpinning Theorem3，我们提供了说明性示例来说明检测器如何导致质量下降。首先，我们考虑质量与检测到的属性负相关的情况，其中质量下降的直觉更加微妙。, we provide illustrative examples for how the detector can lead to decreased quality. First, we consider the case where the quality is negatively correlated with the detected attribute, where the intuition for the quality decrease is more subtle.

实施例4Example 4.

就像示例中一样Like in Example3，考虑基于风格怪癖（例如，过度使用“深入”一词）或参考或事实方面的错误的检测器；然而，假设检测器更加保守，并且不会标记通过足够水平的人类协作生成的内容（即使它标记完全由 LLM 生成的内容）。如果没有检测器，如果法学硕士比人类作者更擅长产生有趣的论点，那么作者可能会产生法学硕士生成的内容。通过检测，如果后处理成本高昂，作者可能会减少使用法学硕士，从而导致内容的论点不那么有趣，但文体怪癖程度也较小。如果相对于减轻文体怪癖所带来的质量增益而言，由于丢失有趣的论点而导致的质量下降足够大，那么检测就会降低内容质量。, consider detectors based on stylistic quirks (e.g., overusage of the word “delve”) or errors in terms of references or facts; however, suppose that the detector is much more conservative and does not flag content produced with a sufficient level of human collaboration (even though it flags fully LLM-generated content). Without a detector, if the LLM is sufficiently more skilled at producing interesting arguments than the human author, the author may produce LLM-generated content. With detection, if post-processing is costly, authors may instead be incentivized to use the LLM less, leading to content with less interesting arguments but also a lesser degree of stylistic quirks. If the quality reduction from losing interesting arguments is sufficiently large relative to the quality gain from mitigating stylistic quirks, detection would reduce content quality.

接下来，我们转向质量与检测到的属性正相关的情况。在这种情况下，直觉更简单：质量下降可以直接来自后处理。Next, we turn to the case where quality is positively correlated with the detected attribute. In this case, the intuition is simpler: the quality decrease can come directly from post-processing.

实施例5Example 5.

相对于人类生成的内容，法学硕士生成的内容往往经过高度打磨。当使用润色进行检测时，用户可能会被激励减少对其 LLM 生成的输出的润色，例如使用自动化工具引入拼写错误。Content generated by LLMs tends to be highly polished relative to human-generated content. When polish is used for detection, users may be incentivized to reduce the polish of their LLM-generated outputs, for example using automated tools to introduce typos.121212参见Seehttps://sinceerly.com/.与没有检测器相比，这种类型的后处理可能会导致用户产生质量较低的输出。This type of post-processing can lead users to produce lower-quality outputs than if there had not been a detector.

对机构的影响。Implications for institutions.

定理Theorem3说明机构不能假设检测将转化为下游输出质量的改进，无论检测器是否惩罚质量降低或质量提高的属性。在附录中illustrates that institutions cannot assume that detection will translate to improvements in downstream output quality, regardless of whether the detector penalizes quality-reducing or quality-increasing attributes. In AppendixE，我们还表明，存在 LLM 检测提高质量的类型，以及相对于无检测器基线，LLM 检测不会导致质量变化的类型。这说明检测对不同用户的质量有不同的影响。, we also show that there exist types where LLM detection increases quality and where LLM detection leads to no change in quality relative to the no-detector baseline. This illustrates that detection has a heterogeneous impact on quality across users.

5 对检测到的属性的影响Impact on Detected Attribute

与部分的失真相反In contrast with the distortion from Section3和部分and Section4，我们表明 LLM 检测对检测到的属性有明显的影响，再现了经验的“上升然后下降”模式。, we show that LLM detection has a clean impact on the detected attribute, reproducing an empirical “rise-then-fall” pattern.

5.1 理论分析Theoretical Analysis

我们证明，当 LLM 被引入世界时，检测到的属性总是微弱地增加，然后当部署 LLM 检测器时，检测到的属性总是微弱地减少。我们还构建了一个用户类型，对于这两个不等式都是严格的。We prove that the detected attribute always weakly increases when LLMs are introduced into the world, and then always weakly decreases when an LLM detector is deployed. We also construct a user type for which both of these inequalities are strict.

图Figure2(a)显示，相对于之前八个三年时间窗口中的所有其他窗口，2022-2025 年符合“先升后降”模式的前 100 个单词中的风格单词数量大幅增加。这说明“先升后降”模式的盛行是LLM时代所特有的。此外，主题词“先升后降”的数量变化要小得多，这凸显了这种趋势对于风格词来说是独一无二的。作为说明性示例，我们在图 1 中描绘了 2022 年至 2025 年一项试验的这些曲线的形状shows that the number of style words in the top 100 words fitting the “rise-then-fall” pattern substantially increases in the 2022-2025 relative to every other window in the preceding eight three-year time windows. This illustrates that high prevalence of the “rise-then-fall” pattern is unique to the LLM era. Moreover, the number of topic “rise-then-fall” words changes much less dramatically, highlighting how this trend is unique to style words. 我们的分析与之前的工作不同Our analysis differs from prior work(Geng and Trotta, 2025)以两种方式：（1）我们系统地研究所有具有高度变化的单词的这种模式，超越了中确定的单词列表in two ways: (1) we systematically study this pattern across all words with a high degree of change, moving beyond the word lists identified inLiang et al. (2025)，(2) 我们将 2022-2025 年“先升后降”模式的流行程度与之前的窗口进行比较。, and (2) we compare the prevalence of the “rise-then-fall” pattern in 2022-2025 to prior windows.

这种先升后降模式的一个可能驱动因素是，用户根据我们的理论分析（定理One possible driver of this rise-then-fall pattern is that users strategically change their workflow decisions in response to LLM detection, along the lines of our theoretical analysis (Theorem4）。然而，我们注意到我们的分析并没有理清因果关系。其他因素可能导致了先升后降的模式，包括较新的法学硕士使用这些词的频率较低。). However, we note our analysis does not disentangle a causal claim. Other factors may have contributed to the rise-then-fall pattern, including newer LLMs using these words less frequently.

6 讨论Discussion

在考虑用户激励的情况下，我们研究了 LLM 检测如何影响下游指标。使用程式化模型，我们证明LLM检测可以反直觉地增加LLM使用率，并证明这种现象的充分条件和必要条件在质量呈线性时匹配。我们还表明，LLM 检测可能会导致输出质量下降，即使检测到的属性会降低质量。相比之下，LLM 检测对其优化的指标有明显的影响，并且我们的模型重现了凭经验观察到的“上升然后下降”模式。We study how LLM detection affects downstream metrics, when taking into account user incentives. Using a stylized model, we show LLM detection can counterintuitively increase LLM usage, and prove sufficient conditions and necessary conditions for this phenomenon which are matching when quality is linear. We also show that LLM detection can lead to reduced output quality, even when the detected attributes are quality-reducing. In contrast, LLM detection has a clean impact on the metric that it optimizes, and our model reproduces an empirically observed “rise-then-fall” pattern.

我们的研究结果揭示了当当前的检测实践被用作引导这些下游指标的干预措施时的关键故障模式。具体来说，我们的结果表明，通过质量降低特征进行检测可能会对法学硕士的使用和输出质量产生与机构预期相反的影响。即使惩罚变得任意严厉，这种效应仍然存在。另一方面，我们的结果表明，通过质量改进特征进行检测将确保检测微弱地减少 LLM 使用，尽管它不会消除输出质量的失真。Our findings reveal key failure modes when current detection practices are used as an intervention to steer these downstream metrics. Specifically, our results show that detection through quality-reducing characteristics can induce the opposite effect on LLM usage and output quality that an institution may have intended. This effect persists even when the penalty becomes arbitrarily severe. On the flip side, our results suggest that detecting via quality-improving characteristics would ensure that detection weakly decreases LLM usage, although it would not remove the distortion in output quality.

模型讨论和局限性。Model discussion and limitations.

我们的模型捕获了 LLM 检测下用户激励的关键方面，包括检测质量影响、部分工作分配、后处理和用户异质性。然而，我们的模型是程式化的，并进行了一些简化。例如，我们假设质量Our model captures key aspects of user incentives under LLM detection, including detection quality effects, fractional work allocation, post-processing, and user heterogeneity. However, our model is stylized and makes several simplifications. For example, we assume that qualityQQ和游戏费用and gaming costsCC跨维度是可分离的。此外，我们假设用户完全知道检测边界，遵循策略分类的标准假设（例如，are separable across dimensions. Moreover, we assume that users exactly know the detection boundary, following standard assumptions from strategic classification (e.g.,(Hardt et al., 2016)）。最后，我们假设人工生成的内容和法学硕士生成的内容的后处理成本相同。未来工作的一个有趣方向是放宽这些假设并将进一步的实际复杂性纳入我们的模型中。). Finally, we assume that post-processing costs are identical for human-generated and LLM-generated content. An interesting direction for future work would be to relax these assumptions and incorporate further practical complexities into our model.

定理9Theorem 9.

考虑定理的设置Consider the setup of Theorem3。检测器的存在提高了某些用户类型的质量. The presence of the detector increases quality for some user type𝐭I\mathbf{t}_{I}: 也就是说，: that is,Q​(z𝐭I​(β,ν;Q,C))>Q​(z𝐭I​(∅;Q,C))Q(z^{\mathbf{t}_{I}}(\beta,\nu;Q,C))>Q(z^{\mathbf{t}_{I}}(\emptyset;Q,C))。对于某些用户类型来说，它也不会导致质量发生变化. It also induces no change in quality for some user type𝐭N\mathbf{t}_{N}: 也就是说，: that is,Q​(z𝐭N​(β,ν;Q,C))=Q​(z𝐭N​(∅;Q,C))Q(z^{\mathbf{t}_{N}}(\beta,\nu;Q,C))=Q(z^{\mathbf{t}_{N}}(\emptyset;Q,C)).

一起定理Together, Theorem3和定理and Theorem9说明 LLM 检测可能会对不同用户的输出质量产生高度异质的影响。这让人怀疑LLM检测是否是提高输出质量的有效干预措施。illustrate that LLM detection can have a highly heterogeneous impact on output quality across users. This casts doubt about whether LLM detection is an effective intervention to improve output quality.

G.1 实证设置的详细信息Details of empirical setup

构建词汇的细节Details of building vocabularyVV.

我们只考虑长度至少为 3 个字母的不间断单词。对于每次试验，我们都会建立一个词汇表We only consider non-stop words that are at least 3 letters long. For each trial, we then build a vocabularyVV由 2013 年 1 月 1 日到 2025 年 12 月 31 日每个月的论文样本数据集中频率最高的 10,000 个单词组成。consisting of the 10,000 words with highest frequency across the sampled dataset with the papers in each month from 1/1/2013 to 12/31/2025.

LLM判断配置的详细信息。Details of LLM judge configuration.

我们使用截至 2026 年 5 月 4 日的最新版本 GPT-5.4-mini。我们将温度设置为默认值。我们将评判提示设为“”“”您是一位分析计算机科学学术论文（arXiv CS 摘要）中词频变化的语言专家。We use the latest version of GPT-5.4-mini as of May 4th, 2026. We set the temperature to be the default value. We take the judge prompt to be “"""You are an expert linguist analyzing word frequency changes in academic computer science papers (arXiv CS abstracts).

一个词的使用频率在一段时间内发生显着变化。将其分类为：A word’s usage frequency changed significantly over a time period. Classify it as either:

-“主题”：频率变化主要是因为该词与研究主题、方法、数据集、工具、技术或特定领域的概念相关，这些概念变得或多或少流行（例如“变压器”、“bert”、“扩散”、“covid”、“区块链”、“联合”、“对抗性”、“修剪”）。- "topic": The frequency change is primarily because the word relates to a research topic, method, dataset, tool, technology, or domain-specific concept that became more or less popular (e.g., "transformer", "bert", "diffusion", "covid", "blockchain", "federated", "adversarial", "pruning").

-“风格”：频率变化主要反映与特定研究主题无关的写作风格、修辞、词语选择或语言模式的变化（例如“深入研究”、“全面”、“值得注意”、“利用”、“关键”、“展示”、“下划线”、“创新”）。- "style": The frequency change primarily reflects a change in writing style, rhetoric, word choice, or language patterns not tied to a specific research topic (e.g., "delve", "comprehensive", "notably", "leveraging", "crucial", "showcasing", "underscores", "innovative").

仅回复“主题”或“风格”。没有其他文字。""""。Respond with ONLY "topic" or "style". No other text."""”.

“先升后降”分类的详细信息。Details of “rise-then-fall” classification.

给出一句话Given a wordww和一个区间索引and an interval indexed byss，我们计算 [10/1/ 中任何季度的单词最大频率, we compute the maximum frequency of the word across any quarter in [10/1/ss, 9/30/(s+3s+3)]。我们要求最大频率至少为)]. We require that the maximum frequency is at leastR=1.5R=1.5乘以第一季度的频率，最终的频率最多为times the frequency in the first quarter, that the final frequency is at mostF=0.95F=0.95乘以最大频率，并且符号变化的次数最多为times the maximum frequency, and that the number of sign changes is at mostC=4C=4.

所有实验均在 1 个 CPU 上运行。All experiments are run on 1 CPU.
